newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Gawler stocks continue to soar.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Gawler stocks continue to soar.

text.p: Shares in mineral explorers with interests in the Gawler Craton gold region in South Australia continued to soar in early afternoon trading on Wednesday after Helix Resources NL released a report confirming more significant gold mineralisation at its Lake Everard project.
Helix shares were up A$1.45 at A$3.30 at 2.05 p.m. (0305 GMT) compared with a price of 45 cents before its initial report that sparked interest in the area on November 18.

Other companies with interests in the Gawler Craton region include Grenfell Resources NL, which was up 15 cents at 79 cents, Equinox Resources NL, up 22 cents at 82 cents, Minotaur Gold NL, up 10 cents at cents to 71 cents, Lakes Oil NL, up half a cent to 5.4 cents and Pima Mining NL, up 10.5 at 36 cents.
"It's been a frenzy," said a Perth broker.
"I've never seen frenzied buying like it before," he said.

"Pima, Equinox, Grenfell are all jumping over the top of each other," the broker said, adding that while the current hectic situation would come off the boil, drilling results seemed to confirm a significant find with rewards for those prepared to ride out the volatility.
"When the hot money turns around, it will be a big rush to get out but it is obviously a fairly significant area where they have been drilling," he said.
"If people have got the patience and are prepared to ride out a bit of volatility, over the longer term they will probably do relatively well if (the find) can be further proved up."
Helix said significant intercepts from Area 223 of the Tunkillia Prospect at Lake Everard included 2.1 grams per tonne (g/t) gold over 92 metres and 3.4 g/t over 72 metres.

The results follow an earlier well-received drilling report on November 18. Helix, which owns 100 percent of the Lake Everard project, said the second line of reverse circulation drilling confirmed the high prospectivity of Area 223.
About 2.23 million Helix shares had traded.
The stock hit a high of A$3.51.
